kept.title: City sidewalk clearing starts at 2 cm of snow; laneways are only salted
kept.detail: The City begins clearing sidewalks once snow reaches 2 cm, and a full clearing cycle typically takes about 12 hours. Public laneways are salted only, within 24 hours after snowfall ends, and are not plowed.

cites.quote: the City begins sidewalk clearing once snow accumulation reaches 2 cm.
The Council-approved winter maintenance service level for public laneways is salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall, to manage icy conditions; snow plowing is not provided.

cites.quote: the TTC provided a list of priority stops and routes, which helped focus clearing efforts on high- traffic and higher-risk locations.
